blocks.html: And to this opinion, that the prisoner was Martin Guerre, the Court had great reason to incline: not only for what has been said, but moreover because this opinion favoured the marriage, the children who are issued of it, and the cause of the accused.

notes.gloss: Satius enim esse impunitum relinqui facinus nocentis quam innocentem damnari — it is better that the crime of a guilty man go unpunished than that an innocent man be condemned.
